gate: 13-gram overlap vs held-out/client bench questions+answers, every section of both eval KBs, ODEX/DS-1000 queries and gold docs

instructions.msmarco: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
instructions.nq: Given a question, retrieve Wikipedia passages that answer the question
instructions.hotpotqa: Given a multi-hop question, retrieve documents that can help answer the question
instructions.stackexchange: Given a question title from a technical Q&A site, retrieve the body of that question
instructions.allnli: Given a premise, retrieve a hypothesis that is entailed by the premise
instructions.quora: Given a question, retrieve questions that are semantically equivalent to the given question
instructions.techdoc: Given a developer question about a software project, retrieve the documentation passage that answers it
